definitions.explanation: Indicates that a state continues unexpectedly up to the present moment. Often carries a sense of surprise or frustration that something has not yet changed. Frequently used with negative predicates.

examples.japanese: {未|いま}だに⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未|いま}だに⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I still can't forget what happened that day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未|いま}だに⟦{解明|かいめい}→解明：14164_kaimei⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cause of the accident has still not been determined.

notes:
USAGE:
{未|いま}だに is often used with negative or unrealized predicates to express that something expected to change has not. It is more literary and emphatic than ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧. Common in written Japanese and formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未|いま}だに⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (still don't understand)
- {未|いま}だに⟦{解決|かいけつ}していない→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧ (still unresolved)
- {未|いま}だに⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (still unforgettable)
- {未|いま}だに⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ (still fresh in memory)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧ is the everyday equivalent meaning 'still' or 'not yet.' {未|いま}だに is more formal and emphasizes the speaker's surprise or dissatisfaction that a situation persists. いまだ (without ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) can also be used, especially before negative forms: いまだ⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧せず (still unresolved).
